purpose: Finite exact-surface fixtures for deterministic extraction regression only.

origin_rules.declared_region_surface: Explicit form in frozen region alias fixture; linked catalog sources give mapping context, not a claim that every inflection is a verbatim archival phrase.
origin_rules.declared_season_alias: Explicit form in frozen season alias fixture mapped to its calendar bucket; this lexical rule is not a quotation from the calendar profile.
origin_rules.declared_social_alias: Explicit form in frozen social alias fixture mapped to the cited rus13 label; editorial paraphrases remain pending review.
origin_rules.occupation_title_exact: Surface equals occupation_title in the pinned TSV row.
origin_rules.occupation_ru_inflection: Listed Russian grammatical form of the cited occupation_title; TSV supports the title, while this rule records the derived inflection.
origin_rules.occupation_editorial_verb: Editorial verb form associated with the cited occupation; not a literal TSV title form and requires separate alias review.
origin_rules.occupation_editorial_work_phrase: Editorial work/activity phrase associated with the cited occupation; not a literal TSV title form and requires separate alias review.
origin_rules.occupation_editorial_translation: Hand-authored English equivalent of the cited Russian title; translation mapping requires separate alias review.
origin_rules.fixture_exact_phrase: Surface occurs literally in the cited frozen case input.
origin_rules.fixture_morphology: Surface is derived by the recorded Russian grammatical transformation from the exact cited case phrase.
origin_rules.candidate_place_chain: Place wording is retained only as an unverified candidate chain; it assigns no region value or eligibility.
origin_rules.unresolved_fixture_surface: Surface is explicitly listed as unresolved in a frozen fixture; no value is assigned.
